create_instance_from_options: create an instance of a registered model class by passing a BaseOptions object to the factory
create_options_by_kind: create a BaseOptions instance by specifying a kind string that matches a registered option type
register_model_class: register a model class with the factory so it can be instantiated via create_instance
load_plugins_into_factory: load and register model classes from setuptools entrypoint plugins into the factory
get_registered_kinds_enum: get an enum of all registered model kinds from the factory for programmatic selection
